name: dsh-version-guard
description: 记录插件版本与 profile 配置快照，在 DSH 无法启动时通过独立恢复页回退到已知可用配置。

audit.notes: Original source is readable and MIT licensed. No package dependencies or install/build lifecycle scripts. Recovery writes profile composition files and local snapshots. Explicit dependency synchronization spawns pnpm install --ignore-scripts; local HTTP recovery uses a request token. No external API credentials are required. Structural and sandbox recovery checks passed; host-version compatibility has not been certified.
